blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Monday passed on final reading a bill institutionalizing a long-term infrastructure strategy to provide consistency in public works planning. The chamber overwhelmingly approved House Bill No. 11597, or the Masterplan for Infrastructure and National Development (MIND) Act, after 284 lawmakers voted in favor and eight against. One
